summary: RetroArr is a self-hosted game library manager designed for both modern PC games and retro console ROMs. It provides tools for metadata scraping, automated indexer searches, download management, and includes a browser-based emulation interface as an alternative to RomM.
goodFor: It is suited for users who want a centralised, self-hosted interface to organise, download, and play their game collections directly in a web browser.
watchOut: As an early-stage project with no tagged releases and minimal visible development activity, it carries a high risk of bugs and missing features compared to more mature alternatives like RomM.
deployNotes: Since it is distributed as a Docker container using .NET, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your game library and metadata storage, along with a reverse proxy for external access.
